proof: `world create` makes a private world whose chain, index, Core and database answer, and `world destroy` removes all of it

checks.check: the world has its owner and an expiry
the chain answers as the seeded chain
the faucet funded the address asked for
the index is running and ready
Core answers its health check for this world
the shared state holds nothing of the world
nothing of the world is left in the accounts
the accounts hold what they held before
